title: Customise right-click context menu options
summary: New menu items (e.g. ‘Listen to this story’) have recently been added to the right-click context menu. I have no interest in these, they mess with my muscle memory, and I would like to remove them: It’s possible to customise the options provided in the right-side story panel, but could this also apply to the right-click context menu?
body_markdown:
[huWkffKNBo](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/huWkffKNBo)


October 29, 2026, 8:14am 1


New menu items (e.g. ‘Listen to this story’) have recently been added to the right-click context menu. I have no interest in these, they mess with my muscle memory, and I would like to remove them:


[image 572×599 59.1 KB](https://forum.newsblur.com/uploads/default/original/2X/e/e817eca1bb08706256bb071b24f1c7461e6f5deb.png)


It’s possible to customise the options provided in the right-side story panel, but could this also apply to the right-click context menu?


[image 959×547 48.1 KB](https://forum.newsblur.com/uploads/default/original/2X/9/92e531bc560fc11ab36e87789c54ff5a4d0d0dd1.png)
